name: tencent-xlog
local_changes: The source owner contains only the xlog, comm, Mars Boost, Zstandard compression and micro-ecc closure; STN, boot, app, baseevent, SDT, bundled OpenSSL, JNI bindings, tests and generated build trees are excluded.

The outer CMake owner compiles static PIC component archives, exposes only tirtc_third::tencent_xlog, defines MARS_NO_OPENSSL, and generates deterministic Mars revision metadata outside the source tree.

The Mars Boost source tree retains its embedded header closure while compiled sources are limited to filesystem, mapped-file and error-code objects used by xlog. Zstandard is reduced to common and compression sources because Runtime configures xlog for write-only zlib/zstd logging.

Common Windows header spellings in the retained comm closure are normalized to their lowercase MinGW filesystem names; Windows zlib-compatible calls use the source-owned miniz target; upstream namespaces, copyrights and log format remain unchanged. tencent-xlog is only the TiRTC owner and CMake target identity.
